walkthroughs.body_html: The biological approach explains behaviour through genes, neurochemistry, brain structure and evolution. Twin studies separate genotype from environment: concordance for schizophrenia is ~48% in MZ twins vs ~17% in DZ twins (Gottesman 1991).

Freud (1923) divided personality into the id (pleasure principle, unconscious), ego (reality principle, conscious) and superego (morality principle). Conflict between them produces anxiety, defended against by repression, denial and displacement.

Freud's five stages — oral (0-1), anal (1-3), phallic (3-6), latent (6-puberty), genital (puberty+). Unresolved conflict at any stage causes fixation (e.g. oral fixation showing as smoking). The Oedipus complex in the phallic stage shapes gender identity.
